messages:
tess: Heads up — I hit a weird edge runtime break in the JS SDK when building our sample app with Vite + esbuild. Repro is small.

omar: ugh, details? stack trace?

te ss: sorry typo, tess: stack: TypeError: (0 , _redwoodDefault.default) is not a function at handler (edge.js:12:7). Happens only when deployed to edge runtime (Cloudflare) and only with `build.target = 'esnext'` + `ssr: true`. Locally with node dev it works.

liam: sounds like conditional exports/default interop to me. Vite + esbuild sometimes drops the CJS fallback and the edge worker expects ESM shape.

omar: can you paste package.json `exports` and import line?

te ss: import in app: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`

te ss: package.json exports: ```json
{"./package.json": "./package.json",".": {"import": "./dist/index.mjs","require": "./dist/index.cjs"}}
```

liam: yep — Vite resolves to the `import` entry, but our bundle transform does a small interop shim that ends up wrapping default under `.default`. Edge runtime execution of the optimized worker removes the shim so the call site expects a function but gets an object.

sarah: did you try `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` as a workaround? that sometimes avoids default import shenanigans.

te ss: tried that — still ends up as object; function call fails. But changing packaging to export a true default in the mjs (i.e., `export default createClient`) fixes it.

omar: hmm, two things to test: 1) build with `ssr: false` to see if vite server transform is the issue, 2) force esbuild to preserveCommonJS or use rollup plugin commonjs with `transformMixedEsModules: true`.

te ss: repro steps I used: 1) npx create-vite sample-app + react 2) add `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` and call `Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW })` 3) build with `vite build --ssr` 4) wrap dist for worker and deploy to CF worker. Fails at cold start.

liam: can you paste the minimal file that fails? and the exact error log from the worker?

te ss: minimal failing file: ```js
// src/edge-handler.js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW })
export default async function handle(req) { return new Response(await client.generate('hi')) }
```

te ss: worker log: `TypeError: Redwood is not a function at handle (edge-handler.js:3:18)`

omar: ok. Proposed fixes: - On SDK side, ensure ESM entry exports a real default to avoid `interopRequireDefault` dependence. - On app side, suggest `import createClient from '@redwood/inference/dist/index.mjs'` as a temporary workaround.

liam: also adding a note in DX docs about bundler pitfalls and recommended config for Vite/Esbuild/Rollup (explicit default export, or prefer `import * as` + `createClient = Redwood.createClient || Redwood.default || Redwood`).

sarah: can we add a short sample-app patch that shows recommended rollup/vite config? I can PR. e.g. rollup commonjs plugin config and `build.rollupOptions.plugins.push(commonjs({transformMixedEsModules: true}))`

te ss: that would be great. I opened a tiny repo to repro and will add links in the ticket. For now I'll pin to `dist/index.mjs` in the sample app.

deploy-bot: deploy started for sample-app-repro (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

omar: follow-up action: @eng-runtime to add a unit test that verifies `import X from '@redwood/inference'` works in a pure ESM environment (edge-like) + add note in SDK packaging checklist.

liam: I'll own the DX docs PR and add a snippet for the try-catch fallback: `const createClient = (Redwood && Redwood.default) ? Redwood.default : Redwood`

te ss: thanks all — repro link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/vite-edge-repro (I will add exact files). Filing a ticket: INF-4238.

sarah: ok leaving a short note in onboarding guide so folks avoid this when trying the sample app. :+1:
